audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Ryze wins Level 6 while every prose line (whys[4], phases[4].why, spikes[1]) called level 6 Renekton's cleanest solo-kill window.
audit.why: Dominus (R, 120/100/80s) grants bonus HP and periodic Fury; Ryze gains only Realm Warp, a 3000-range delayed group teleport with no combat power. Nothing at 6 favours Ryze.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flipped to Renekton in both layers (phases[4].side and win[4]), rating 3/10 -> 6/10.

audit.why: Spikes are level 2 (Slice and Dice online), level 6 Dominus, first item, and late Ryze scaling — all four present and ordered.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike text kept; phases[4].why rewritten to state the Dominus mechanism instead of a generic 25-minute claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Prison was described repeatedly as a 'point-blank root'. It is 615 range, and per Riot's text it roots ONLY if Flux (from Spell Flux, E) is on the target — otherwise it is a slow. The 'Q bounces' description of Overload is also wrong: Overload is a line missile that stops on the first enemy struck.
audit.why: The whole gameplan is timed off Rune Prison. Its real cooldown is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, not 'roughly 13 seconds', and the root condition tells you when the dash-in is actually safe.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the Rune Prison lines with 615 range, the Flux root condition, and 11s-at-rank-1; corrected Overload to a first-target line missile that minions block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Concrete numbers make the pattern executable: Rune Prison 11s, Slice and Dice 16s at rank 1, Dominus 120s.

edits.before: Fury autos bully the first waves. Identify how Ryze contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Overload pokes on a 5s cooldown — stand behind minions, take nothing for free, and reach level 2 at full health.

edits.before: E-in trades begin — bank 50 fury before you slice. Only take the trade when Ryze's Rune Prison is down.
edits.after: Slice and Dice unlocks — bank 50 fury, then E-in and empowered-W stun before his 11s Rune Prison returns.

edits.before: Dominus stats turn even fights into wins before 25 minutes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ryze's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Dominus HP absorbs his full rotation and feeds Fury for a second empowered W — this is your cleanest solo-kill window at 6.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 615-range cage that only roots if Spell Flux is on you — 11s cooldown. Engage once it is spent.

edits.before: Track Ryze's Rune Prison: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. When it is down — Fury W-stun + dash out.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only if Spell Flux hit first — unfluxed it is a slow. It is down 11s once he spends it: W-stun window.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison: 11s at rank 1, 9s at rank 5, and it only roots you if Spell Flux is already on you. Track it. - Slice and Dice: 16s at rank 1 — never spend it on chip. - Dominus: 120s — kill windows only.

edits.before: At level 1 Ryze has real poke with Q and his passive Arcane Mastery keeps its cooldown short — stand behind minions so his Q bounces hit a wave unit instead of you, and accept a cautious first wave. The moment you hit level 2 the entire dynamic flips: E through him, immediately W-stun before he can cast Rune Prison, then Q-heal back the chip damage and E out on the second half of Slice and Dice. He cannot trade back into a point-and-click stun and your Q sustain covers the poke you ate getting there. By level 3 your full kit lets you run the pattern repeatedly — track his Rune Prison cooldown visually (it is roughly 13 seconds early) and never dash in while it is available.
edits.after: At level 1 Ryze pokes with Overload (Q) on a 5-second cooldown that his other spells reset — it is a line missile that stops on the first enemy struck, so keep a minion between you and accept a cautious first wave. The moment you hit level 2 the dynamic flips: E through him, W-stun instantly before he can cast Rune Prison, Q-heal the chip, and E out on the second half of Slice and Dice. He cannot answer a point-and-click stun and your Q sustain covers the poke you ate getting there. By level 3 run the pattern on his Rune Prison timer — 11 seconds at rank 1, 9 at rank 5, and it only roots you if Spell Flux landed first. Unfluxed it is just a slow, so the dash-in is safer than it looks.

edits.before: Root you with Rune Prison (W) mid-dash so your E is wasted and his full Q-E combo fires uncontested
edits.after: Land Spell Flux (E) first so Rune Prison roots instead of slows, wasting your dash and freeing his full rotation

notes: Mirror (ryze__renekton) not yet audited. Rune Prison's root-requires-Flux condition and Overload's first-target line behaviour were the two factual errors; both were repeated across several fields. Spell-shield/QSS/tenacity interactions were not asserted — not in Riot's text.
